purpose: Target userspace package and reproducibility contract
acquisition: Signed Debian InRelease / Packages; verify SHA256 and size before locking
assembly: Offline .deb payload extraction only; no maintainer scripts, no host installation
mandatory_validation: ELF interpreter and DT_NEEDED paths within rootfs
limitations: T04 produces a userspace layer, not a bootable image
ELF path checks do not replace symbol-version or real XTOS guest validation
Runtime needs deterministic XTOS provisioning of alternatives, CA store and accounts
license_records: Retain each package's /usr/share/doc/<name>/copyright and source URL
